lines.text: Mind the crust. It bites. So do I. Dessa Harl. Rake chief.
I am looking for the well.
Everybody is. The well is Oda's. The salt is mine. The water is neither. Do not tell her I said that.

choice.text: I would like to ask your crew before I dig. It is your flats.
Something is glinting under the crust. I am digging.

lines.text: Asking. Huh. Fine. Fourteen paces south. Leave the lichen bed whole.
Mine, friend. Whatever it is. You ask first.
